design: Controlled geometry for deriving and breaking interpretable S7 rules. Semantic labels are intentional experimental labels, not thresholds.

cases.name: baseline_cube
cases.purpose: Negative control: S5 still has a best cut, but there is no attached defect.

cases.name: protrusion_small
cases.purpose: Small compact bulb attached through a narrow neck.

cases.name: protrusion_medium
cases.purpose: Medium compact bulb with the same neck geometry.

cases.name: protrusion_large
cases.purpose: Large compact bulb with the same neck geometry.

cases.name: flat_flap
cases.purpose: Legitimate sheet-like appendage; tests rod-vs-sheet geometry handling.

cases.name: defect_spike
cases.purpose: Failure case for any rule that assumes elongated means legitimate.

cases.name: legitimate_knob
cases.purpose: Failure case for any rule that assumes compact + weak neck means defect.

cases.name: legitimate_compact_boss
cases.purpose: Legitimate compact broad-base feature; tests whether attachment constriction distinguishes blended compact geometry from a narrow-neck compact protrusion.
